titulekPuvodni: Ukraine: Estonia sends clear message to Russia by closing border crossings
shrnuti: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has praised Estonian security services for thwarting a Russian-directed attack on drone maker Threod Systems and urges stronger European pressure on Moscow.

Andrii Sybiha. Photo: Sybiha's social media

Source: Sybiha on X (Twitter) ; European Pravda
Details: Sybiha noted that Ukraine expresses its full solidarity with Estonia in connection with the attempted arson attack on the Estonian defence company Threod Systems.

Pohyb ruské sabotážní skupiny Černí Rusové byl důvodem rozsáhlé operace polských bezpečnostních sil u hranic s ruskou Kaliningradskou oblastí. Uvedl to polský veřejnoprávní rozhlas Polskie Radio 24. Varšava na severovýchodě svého území zřídila speciální jednotku. Reagovala tak na varování rozvědky před možnými ruskými sabotážemi a vpády přes hranice.
Foto: Kuba Stezycki, Reuters
Polští vojáci z 18. mechanizované divize hlídají polskou hranici s Běloruskem
Článek
„V reakci na hrozbu sabotáží posílily polské bezpečnostní složky ochranu hranic,“ vysvětlila stanice přesuny na polské straně hranice s ruskou Kaliningradskou oblastí. Velení polských bezpečnostních sil vyslalo do Podlaského a Varmijsko-mazurského vojvodství posily, včetně příslušníků polské speciální jednotky GROM, dalších příslušníků pohraniční stráže a policejních protiteroristických jednotek.
Podle polského premiéra Donalda Tuska se posily aktivovaly, když pohraničníci v noci na úterý zaznamenali…

titulekPuvodni: Norway strengthens border surveillance system to detect drones near Russia
shrnuti: Norway is deploying NASAMS sensors in Kirkenes and reinforcing its military presence with over 30 soldiers to detect drones near the Russian border.

vyrez.text:
Norway deploys drone detection system near Russian border | Ukrainska Pravda
The Norwegian flag. Photo: Getty Images
The Norwegian Armed Forces are deploying an aerial surveillance system in the town of Kirkenes, near the Russian border, to detect drones that stray off course at an early stage.
Source: a press release by the Norwegian government, as reported by European Pravda
Details: The Norwegian Air Force is deploying specialised NASAMS sensors, while the military garrison in the region will be reinforced by more than 30 soldiers.
Advertisement:





"We have seen in other countries that drones can go astray. This is something Norway takes seriously. We must be prepared, even though we do not currently see an increased aerial threat to Norway or the population of Finnmark," said Norwegian Defence Minister Tore O. Sandvik.
The government noted that the measures are preventive and are not linked to any specific new threat.
The sensors are designed to detect drones, warn of their presence and provide a comprehensive picture of all activity in the airspace over border areas.

shrnuti: Latvia issued an air-raid warning in two eastern municipalities overnight after an unidentified drone entered its airspace and crashed near the Russian border.

NATO aircraft and interceptor drones deployed after unidentified drone crashes in Latvia | Ukrainska Pravda
Aircraft. Stock photo: MIL.LV/LV
An air-raid warning was issued in Latvia's Ludza and Balvi municipalities on the night of 2-3 November after an unidentified drone was detected. The object crashed in the Balvi area.
Source: European Pravda, citing the Latvian National Armed Forces
Details: An air-raid warning was issued in the Ludza and Balvi municipalities at 00:10 on 2 November. Fighter jets from NATO's Baltic Air Defence mission were deployed in the airspace over the Baltic states. In response to the threat, the Latvian Armed Forces also deployed interceptor drones.

According to early reports, the object that triggered the alert crashed in the Balvi municipality, near the Russian border. Ground search operations have begun there.
The Latvian National Armed Forces urged members of the public not to approach or touch any suspicious objects or debris they might find and to call the emergency number 112 immediately.

Russia says it has recorded the biggest Ukrainian drone attack since the war began, in which a landmark bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea sustained minor damage and several oil refineries were hit.

Unidentified assailants attempted to set fire to a defense plant belonging to Threod Systems, an Estonian drone manufacturer, overnight on November 14.
The Estonian Internal Security Service, known as KaPo, detained eight residents of Latvia whose citizenship was not specified. Prosecutors requested that five of the eight be arrested.

Pětice evropských zemí hodlá odmítnuté žadatele o azyl posílat do deportačního centra v africké Rwandě. Svůj záměr by měly oznámit během pondělí na Vídeňské migrační konferenci. S odvoláním na své zdroje o tom v pondělí informovaly agentura Reuters či týdeník The Economist.

Dohoda navazuje na říjnové zpřísnění unijní migrační politiky, které zahrnuje i možnost zřídit návratová…

titulekPuvodni: Estonian security chief: 'I hope Latvia will take sufficient measures'
shrnuti: Estonian public media ERR News has an interesting interview with the country's security service chief concerning a recent incident in which eight Latvian nationals were arrested on suspicion of a Russia-backed sabotage plot.

Authors:

Estonian public media ERR News has an interesting interview with the country's security service chief concerning a recent incident in which eight Latvian nationals were arrested on suspicion of a Russia-backed sabotage plot.
In the interview Estonian Internal Security Service (ISS/KAPO) Director General Margo Palloson acknowledges the assistance received from his Latvian counterparts in foiling the plot and also considers the wider implications – which may include the complete closure of Estonia's border with Russia.
That in turn could make it advisable for Latvia to follow suit, it is intimated.

Krymský most po útoku ukrajinských dronů.
Článek

Skip to main content
Advertisement
TALLINN — Imagine French General Charles de Gaulle, exiled in London during World War II, running his Free France government by logging into the cloud.
Officials in Estonia are preparing for exactly such a scenario with a new strategy to boost doomsday resilience — hukukindlus in Estonian — that would allow the government’s digital services to be run entirely from abroad if its territory is occupied by a foreign enemy.
The Baltic country of 1.3 million, which shares a 294-kilometer border with Russia, fears it is a prime target if Moscow were to invade a European Union country. Security services have already warned that Russia is waging a hybrid war on Europe, and Estonia has blamed Moscow for everything from cyberattacks to arson plots to cuts to undersea data cables .

Belgium Five injured after gas explosion at Christmas market in Maredsous
Marc Hoscheid
Andy Brücker
adapted for RTL Today
Five people were injured, two of them seriously, after a gas cylinder exploded at a Christmas market in Maredsous in Belgium on Sunday.
Published: 15.11.26 15:18 , Update: 15.11.26 15:18
© Archiv
An explosion occurred at a Christmas market in Maredsous, near Namur, Belgium, on Sunday, leaving five people injured. Two of the victims are reported to be in serious condition.
The incident was caused by the explosion of a propane gas cylinder, which subsequently started a fire at the market.
Authorities have closed the Christmas market for the remainder of the day as investigations continue.

shrnuti: "Estonia is preparing for the possibility of closing its border with Russia," said Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal.

vyrez.text:
Estonia accuses Russia of attempted arson attack on defense firm – POLITICO
Skip to main content
Advertisement
Estonia has accused Russia's military intelligence service of ordering an attempted arson attack on an Estonian drone maker, prompting Tallinn to threaten to close its border with Russia.
Intruders were found at Threod Systems in Viimsi, outside the Estonian capital, shortly after 3 a.m. on Saturday trying to break into the building with the aim of setting it on fire and causing an explosion, Prosecutor General Astrid Asi said Sunday.
Writing on X , Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said: "This is part of Russia’s broader hybrid war against Europe, with the aim of decreasing support to Ukraine and pressure on Russia. We will not be intimidated."
Advertisement
He added that "Estonia is preparing for the possibility of closing its border with Russia to reduce the risks to our people and national security."
Threod's security staff stopped the attack before it could cause significant damage, authorities said. Eight suspects, all residents of neighboring Latvia, were detained. Five have been remanded in custody.

Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has said that the most Russian ruler Vladimir Putin can currently negotiate is a just ceasefire along the current line of contact, not a division of spheres of influence in Europe.
Source: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha on X (Twitter)
Quote: " At this stage, the most Putin can negotiate is a fair ceasefire along the current line of contact, not spheres of influence in Europe. "

November 13, 2026, 11:53 pm
Source: ZDF
Germany’s parliament has approved a bill significantly expanding the powers of the country’s intelligence agencies. The law aims to counter espionage, terrorism, and sabotage, the newspaper Die Welt reported.
The changes apply to the Federal Office for the Protection of the Constitution (BfV) and the Federal Intelligence Service (BND).
The law allows the agencies to:
Secretly enter homes
Carry out cyberattacks on foreign IT systems
Delete or alter data or redirect internet traffic
Use AI to analyze biometric data
Recruit teenagers 16 and older as informants in exceptional cases
A special body, including former judges, will review whether proposed measures are legal before the agencies carry them out.
The authorities said the law was needed because of growing hybrid threats from Russia, China, and Iran.

Image source, AFP via Getty Images
Image caption, In future, German spies working for the BND foreign intelligence service will be able to conduct covert operations abroad
By Bethany Bell Germany reporter
Published
2 hours ago
Germany's foreign and domestic intelligence services are to be given greater powers to combat espionage, terrorism and sabotage after the country's parliament, the Bundestag, approved a major overhaul of its legislation.
Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt, who championed the bill, has called it a "reform of the century", necessary because of the increasing threats from foreign powers.

13 November 2026 at 06:00

ROME – The intelligence services had warned days earlier that, after aircraft, schools could be the next targets. Politicians have been debating the issue for years. Twelve months ago, Defence Minister Guido Crosetto unveiled a plan setting out the structures, powers and tools needed to respond.
A country caught unprepared
(lapresse)
Yet when an email threatening bombings and massacres reached 6,000 schools across the country, Italy was caught off guard. Not when it came to the investigation, but in its handling of the emergency.
In the same family, one child may have been evacuated while another was left in the classroom. The same threat, two different responses. And one question: who decides what action should be taken?
Proof of the country's lack of preparedness came the following day, when the authorities scrambled to put things right: new threat emails were ignored, and work began on drawing up a protocol for managing this type of risk. It was a response that should have come…

Russia has developed several ways to pressure people into joining the military, including offering military contracts to those facing fines or financial problems, said Oleksii Melnyk, co-director of the foreign relations and international security programs at the Ukrainian Razumkov Center.

Erneut Bombendrohungen gegen Schulen in Italien
Stand: 12.11.2026 • 15:25 Uhr
In Italien sind erneut Bombendrohungen an Schulen gesendet worden. Es sollen etwa 1.600 Einrichtungen betroffen sein. Die Regierung will Gebäude künftig nur noch räumen lassen, wenn konkrete Hinweise auf eine Gefahr vorliegen.
Hunderte Schulen in Italien haben erneut Bombendrohungen per E-Mail erhalten. Einige Bildungseinrichtungen wurden Medienberichten zufolge evakuiert. Die Regierung von Ministerpräsidentin Giorgia Meloni hat jedoch nach eigenen Angaben über die zuständigen Ministerien die lokalen Behörden und jeweiligen Schulleitungen darüber informiert, dass der Schulbetrieb regulär fortgesetzt werden soll.
Bereits am Mittwoch hatten etwa 6.000 Schulen solche Droh-E-Mails erhalten. Heute gingen nach Angaben der Nachrichtenagentur Ansa bei etwa 1.800 Einrichtungen Drohungen ein. Auffällige Funde gab es in den betroffenen Schulen aber nicht.

Predseda vlády SR Robert Fico (Smer-SD) vo štvrtok popoludní odcestoval do írskeho Dublinu, kde sa zúčastní na záverečnom plenárnom zasadnutí Európskeho politického spoločenstva (EPC) a na neformálnom samite lídrov členských krajín Európskej únie.
Premiér mal z Bratislavy pôvodne odletieť približne o 9.00 h, jeho odchod sa však napokon posunul na popoludnie. Úvodné plenárne zasadnutie EPC sa v Dubline začalo o 11.30 h miestneho času (12.30 h SEČ). Záverečné zasadnutie sa začne o 17.15 h miestneho času (18.15 h SEČ) a Fico by sa na ňom…
